Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920: C Ss. 28, 55 and its Proviso: Insolvency Petition by the debtor/transferor--Bonafide transferee for valuable consideration-Protection to-Held: When transfer of shares to the transferee was for valuable consideration without any notice as to the presentation of the entitled to protection/claim. Section 218/Proviso to Section 55--Protection to creditor vis-a-vis-­ Protection to bona fide transferee-Interpretation of-Held, An order of adjudication in an Insolvency Petition relates back to the date of its presentation-No word or Provision of Law
